title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Miscellaneous Measures) Bill 2014
short_title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Miscellaneous Measures) Bill 2014

speeches.speaker: Bob Baldwin
speeches.brief: Moved amendments to the offshore petroleum levies act to prevent a related bill's expansion of coastal waters from creating a constitutional risk, by keeping the levy regime limited to its existing geographic definition rather than extending it to newly conferred state and territory waters.

speeches.speaker: Gary Gray
speeches.brief: Explained that the discovery of rocky features at Scott and Seringapatam Reefs has redrawn Western Australia's maritime boundary, giving the state a majority interest in the Torosa gas field and a stronger say over how the Browse Basin, discovered in 1974, and holding an estimated 300 million barrels of condensate and 14 trillion cubic feet of gas, is developed.

speeches.speaker: David Gillespie
speeches.brief: Supported the Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Miscellaneous Measures) Bill 2014, warning that $134 billion of potential gas development is at risk due to high costs, and explained the bill will let NOPSEMA and NOPTA continue regulating Browse Basin titles despite a maritime boundary change.

speeches.speaker: Karen Andrews
speeches.brief: Summed up debate on a package of Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage amendment bills, explaining they let states and the Northern Territory confer regulatory powers on NOPSEMA and guarantee security of tenure for titleholders when a maritime boundary change moves their block into Commonwealth waters.

acts.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Miscellaneous Measures) Act 2015
